interaction-states.twistDescription: Hover transition speed made more languid (+0.15s) across inputs, links, cards, and navigation for a smoother, understated cinematic-premium feel.

motion-system.twistDescription: Duration scaling slower x1.5 (Twist A, intensity 3): all transition durations lengthened for languid, cinematic atmospheric drift; no color or easing changes.

nav-system.twistDescription: Nav twist F (link hover): introduced a background pill highlight on nav-link hover; geometry left unchanged, no color changes.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Global spacing scale factor x1.2 for generous, breathing dark-cinematic space (border-radius unchanged)

type-system.twistDescription: Twist A — heading font-size scale shifted down x0.9 for a restrained, Linear-esque editorial display scale (no color/font changes)

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A — container max-width expanded 1436px -> 1600px for a wider composed widescreen canvas; 77px cinema-margin gutters retained.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Reframed the Content Sections paragraph into a material register — surfaces, borders, and depth described as physical substance (cast stone, milled slabs, timber grain) while keeping every token, ratio, and measurement intact.
